Teacher notes

Search a tool, machine or function. Each dictionary item appears once. Assemble or place the model, then press Switch on or Show function to see its use. Explore 3D lets students inspect it from different directions.

Function scenes are teaching illustrations. Measurements are examples, not live readings. Sound effects represent the action; normally silent devices remain silent. Moving parts and outcomes are simplified for explanation.

British drill recordings and click effects are built in. Touch a part to start audio. Other words prefer an installed UK voice; another English device voice is used if needed. Effects and voice start enabled at 85% app volume. Set the device Media volume too. Reduced-motion settings pause automatic movement; use Next step in the function panel.
